prompt: Our customers say they buy our product because of quality and price. But when we removed the premium packaging, sales dropped 30%. Something doesn't add up.
rationale: Tests whether the skill correctly identifies that stated rational reasons may be rationalizations

prompt: We need to reduce the price of our SaaS product to increase conversions.
rationale: Decoy: pricing strategy should trigger pain-of-payment, not this skill

prompt: Help me write a survey to ask customers why they churn.
rationale: Decoy: survey design should trigger observe-don't-ask, not this skill (unless this IS the suspicion skill)

prompt: Our ad shows the product in a luxury setting but customers seem turned off. The product is mid-priced.
rationale: Decoy: symbol inconsistency should trigger product-symbolic-meaning-decode, not this skill (unless this IS that skill)

prompt: We have the best logical argument but our board won't approve it. They keep finding irrational objections.
rationale: Tests whether the skill identifies mental blocks vs logical argumentation
